title: Factorization of matching Fourier weight
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let an edge assignment label the edges of a perfect matching in the complete multipartite graph with $q$ parts of $k$ vertices each by elements of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The Fourier weight of the induced vertex labeling is the product, over all parts, of the absolute values of the Fourier coefficients indexed by the sets of labels assigned to the matching edges incident to each part.
